title: Not Impressed
text: I have gotten 3 shipments so far and I'm not impressed at all. My grandson is 3 and I have the 3-4 year old subscription. He is extremely bright, but the toys I am being sent are way too advanced for his age  or so utterly boring they aren't worth it at all. I'll give it a month or two longer, but if the items I am sent do not improved I'll cancel it for sure.
label: neutral
